items.title: How much does a real-infrastructure test suite cost as it grows?
items.description: L1's numbers: a test hitting real Postgres costs about 45ms; the same test against an in-memory adapter costs about 0.05ms. Neither number changes what's being tested — only which adapter is plugged in. Drag the number of tests and the real-adapter latency to see how the two suites' total runtimes diverge as the suite grows — this is the actual, compounding cost of a core that can't be tested without its adapters.
items.compute: const memMs = 0.05; const suiteTimeRealDb = (params.numTests * params.dbLatencyMs) / 1000; const suiteTimeInMemory = (params.numTests * memMs) / 1000; return { suiteTimeRealDb, suiteTimeInMemory };
